messages:
Marta (Design): Small but annoying bug: on narrow screens the Export and Copy buttons drop below the fold in the Vectors preview. Screenshot attached. Thoughts?
Leo (Frontend): Repro'd on 1366x768. Table's preview column forces width. Quick fix: collapse the vector preview into a per-row chevron and make actions a sticky overlay on the right.
Sam (Product): We also need to stop CSV truncation of vector fields. Customers hit broken downstream parsing when vectors get clipped. Can we offer safer formats?
Ivy (ML): Recommend NDJSON and ZIP bundle with a small _meta.json (dataset_id, rows, dim). NDJSON avoids CSV quoting issues. Server should estimate file size and recommend format.
Rita (A11y): Accessibility: sticky actions must be in the tab order and announce when modal opens. Export dialog needs role=dialog, aria-labelledby, and focus trap. Also ensure delta scores have text fallback like "+0.07" for screen readers.
Marta (Design): Copy for export checkbox: "Include full vectors (may be very large)". Warning modal: "This export may exceed 100MB. We recommend NDJSON for large datasets." Primary CTA: "Start export".
Leo (Frontend): I'll switch client serialization to Blob streaming and call a server endpoint to compute estimated compressed size. For large exports we'll present NDJSON + ZIP option and a confirm step.
Sam (Product): Product decision: default to CSV for small exports; if estimated size > 50MB auto-select NDJSON and show explanation. Limit full-vector CSV to 15k rows for self-serve. Enterprise override via support.
Marta (Design): Follow-ups: add 'Condensed rows' toggle in toolbar (Ctrl+Shift+C) and ensure preview collapse animation respects reduced-motion. I'll post updated mocks.
ci-bot: Created issue UI-5031: "Vectors preview responsive actions + safe export (NDJSON, manifest, size estimate)" and linked mockups.
